scope: General bounded read-only ELF program-header/LOAD VMA/file/BSS mapping. Native ELF ZIP read only. No ISO/registry/emulator/process/native execution or production/test changes.
baseline: Frozen image_layout contract includes ELF/disc/sentinel mapping, self-consistent loader/window capacity and bounded reservations; this next increment covers only general ELF mapping/report, not entirefamily.

source_facts.addr: tools/addr.py and compatibility addresses.py implement two historical constantVMA windows. Newsegment guard accepts exact preappend filesize for PLANNING or postappend filesize; it does NOT parse ELF PH or establish loaded bytes. VMA conversion rejects outside declared windows; inverse adds chosen delta withoutbounds and is intentionally permissive. Generic source-derived mapping deliberately replaces those assumptions; do not relabel it exact legacy behavior.
source_facts.layout_audit: inspect_elf_layout ->verify.elf_layout_check_elf_program_headers decodes two expected littleendian PH tuples. Other duties check fixed crt0 heap/syscallwords, ISO directoryextents/dualendianfields and ZERO.BIN filename references. Those duties are NOT satisfied by generic segmentmap, and ZERO absence is not runtime reachabilityproof.
source_facts.callers: relocate_pointer_array/code_immediate/settings/class_tooltip and rerelocate combine explicit ISO_ELFbase with addr.vma_to_file_off. Their pointer/opcode/header/ledger checks remain separate. relocate_gp_relative derivesGP from SHT_MIPS_REGINFO separately; LOADmapping does not prove GP reachability.

native_frozen_observation.qualification: Frozen executable contains filetail outside original filebacked LOAD ranges; appended data/runtime sentinel redirection is NOT automatic PT_LOAD mapping. Empty native LOAD remains metadata, not evidence of allocated storage.

native_ranges.tail_qualification: Fileoffset439700 onward has no LOAD-backedVMA from these headers, even though frozenmember is5087232B. Does not classify runtime sentinel loader mapping.

stdlib.usable: debug/elf.NewFile accepts io.ReaderAt, decodes class/byteorder/programheaders into standard ProgHeader inclOff,Vaddr,Paddr,Filesz,Memsz,Flags,Align. Use io.SectionReader bounded to actual source extent; no manual second ELF parser/dependency.
stdlib.limits: NewFile source288..445 checks magic/class/endian/version, header sizes/truncated PH data and signed offset/Filesz admissibility. It creates SectionReaders without validating fullsegment EOF, Filesz<=Memsz,32bit memorywrap, LOAD overlap or align/congruence. Caller must impose selected mapping contract. Section metadata may also be parsed/refused by stdlib; first contract need not emulate permissive legacy invalidheaders.
stdlib.primary_spec: https://gabi.xinuos.com/elf/07-pheader.html sections7.1/7.2: PT_LOAD fileprefix and zero-initialized memorytail, Filesz<=Memsz,align0/1or power2 and Vaddr/Off congruence. This gives memoryimage semantics, not actual running-loader or cave availability.
stdlib.license: Use installed standard library via import; no vendored/copied implementation or added dependency. Source files carry Go BSD-style license notice.

selected_root_direction.owner: Enhance existing inspect via early elf_layout branch. Existing inspection responsibility already owns bounded image reads/native readiness; genericmapper need not become newfunction/helper. Main shares pinnedsource/read/recheck/JSON report routing with reference_candidates. Keep existing fixed-delta patch/font/stream branches unchanged.
selected_root_direction.data: One new Recipes.AddressRanges map[string]AddressRange keyed stableIDs or labels; no patch Entries/ReadBytes/reference scan overload. No new ISOflags/profile. Root owns final schema/limits.
selected_root_direction.report: Standard debug/elf.ProgHeader LOAD records with original PH index/order; each named halfopenVMA range split at fileprefix/BSS/segment/hole boundaries into file_backed,bss,unmapped. Only file_backed has ELF file offsets. PhysicalPaddr is metadata, not VMA substitute.
selected_root_direction.refusals: Reject overlapping nonempty PT_LOAD memory intervals,Filesz>Memsz,payload outsideactualsource,32bit memorywrap,invalidalign/congruence; bound querycount/reportrows/source/header reads. Reject empty/reversedquery. Query start uint32,exclusiveend can2^32. EmptyLOAD accepted and reported but maps nothing.
selected_root_direction.coverage: Queries represent unmapped spans explicitly rather than speculative constantdelta/BSSfileoffset. NumericAddressRange parser must accept endpoint2^32 separately from existing number uint32parser; do not globallyrelax existing patch-addressguards.

precode.method: Independent stdlib struct fixtureconstruction and manually authored expected split rows, arithmetic/coverage asserts. No Go outputs/projectPython used. Includes two distinct LOADdeltas,BSS-only,emptyLOAD,hole,boundarysplit,last32bitendpoint,sentinelunmapped,7 defects and4invalidqueries.

safety_limits: BSS is zero-initialized memory with NO filebytes; never invent physical fileoffsets or read padding asBSS.
Mapped/filebacked/zero does not mean unreferenced,free,executable,writeable at runtime,safe cave or approved reservation.
Filesystem size, ELFLOAD size, ISOextent, streamblob capacity, loadersectorcount, sentinelwindow and heap boundaries are distinct facts.
No allocation,growth,write/repoint,GPrelocation,section/cave ownership or native runtime/visual proof from this report.
No generalELF64/endian/ET_DYN/loadbias feature scope added merely because stdlib can parse them; parent chooses finite supported header contract.
